instruction: Make me an amazon account with yearly prime membership.
notes: The supervisor has no amazon account, so the agent signs up with the supervisor's first/last name and email (from supervisor.show_profile) and an agent-chosen password (modelled as the static (password-for amazon amazon-new-password) fact; passwords-known is only needed for the gmail login). Signup is assumed to automatically email a verification code to the supervisor's gmail; the agent logs into gmail (password from show_account_passwords), searches the inbox for the verification thread, reads the code with show_thread, verifies the account, then logs into amazon. amazon.send_verification_code is included only as a fallback producer of (verification-sent amazon) and is not needed in the reference plan. A payment card is added from supervisor.show_payment_cards (amazon.PaymentCard changes are ignored by the evaluation) and used for subscribe_prime with duration 'yearly'; the target duration is enforced via the static (target-duration duration-yearly) fact, and the goal state is account-exists + account-verified + prime-subscribed for amazon. The task asks no question, so supervisor-complete-task takes no answer and is forced last via (task-completed).
